verdicts.rationale: The only divergence hint is Pyro particle generation, which is constitution-excluded (energy/particles). No effect is authored and there is no rendered buff/timing surface to diverge from. Nothing decision-relevant to a rotation timeline is omitted.

verdicts.rationale: The +15% DMG effect is authored with an enemyHpAbove:50 condition that resolves optimistically, so it renders as an always-on buff window. Per the CAN list, enemyHpAbove is optimistic-by-design and its explanatory caveat is legitimate — never implementDelete. The curator expected the standard 'assumed to hold' note but the character shipped zero caveats, so a real decision-relevant divergence (a continuous buff that in game drops off once the enemy is below 50% HP) is unmarked. [Adjudicated per wave-2 verifier REJECT: passive-trigger constellation buffs emit no windows (deriveBuffWindows dispatch + caption walk both skip them; probe-confirmed), so the shown-as-always-active premise is false. Queued: renderer follow-up + class sweep if it lands.]
rubricRefs: add: optimistic enemyHpAbove condition; keep/rewrite, never implementDelete

groundedIn.quote: Resolves to null at planner-time so the buff renders optimistically with the standard 'assumed to hold' caveat (same treatment as Razor C2 / Yanfei C1 / Eula C4 enemy-HP gates).

groundedIn.claim: In game the DMG bonus only applies to enemies whose HP is above 50%
groundedIn.quote: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

verdicts.rationale: No effect is authored. The trigger is 'when Diluc takes DMG' (onPlayerHit / HP-decrease), which is on the CANNOT-model list of unconsumed HP-change triggers and is not optimistic-by-design — rendering a reactive defensive buff as always-on would mislead. The only implement path is a manual trigger for a non-deterministic combat-reactive buff, which the Wriothesley A4 precedent leaves unauthored; the ATK SPD half is also constitution-excluded. Not a rotation decision.
rubricRefs: noCaveat: CANNOT-model onPlayerHit/HP-change trigger, non-deterministic; ATK SPD constitution-excluded

groundedIn.claim: No effect is authored and the mechanic rides an onPlayerHit (take-damage) trigger the model does not support
groundedIn.quote: No effect authored. Pattern: stack-on-hit buff (max 3 stacks) … Likely trigger: `onPlayerHit` (gcsim subscribes to event.OnPlayerHit) … Schema has no stack-count concept on effects; reviewer to decide whether to extend or to model as a single 30%/15% buff with caveats.
